elements.label: A New Start?
elements.description: A chance to regroup and make a comeback.

elements.label: Serious Injury
elements.description: A major setback! This kind of damage cannot heal without external help.

elements.label: Wound
elements.description: The flesh always has its limits. [Some wounds heal with the passage of time, but sustaining three wounds of any kind at once will prove fatal.]

elements.label: Ally
elements.description: Those who share benefits with me.

elements.label: Foe
elements.description: We will settle this, sooner or later.

elements.label: Immortal
elements.description: For now, this person has escaped the curse of time—but nothing truly lasts forever.

elements.label: Location
elements.description: A place worth going to. I might find something here, or carry out some work.

elements.label: Season
elements.description: What I foresee will come to pass...

elements.label: hidden aspect: rifle
elements.description: A hidden mark for rifles.

elements.label: Ammunition
elements.description: Unarrived flames.

elements.label: Molten
elements.description:
Emitting infernal-like heat, capable of melting through supernatural defenses.

[Using this to attack nullifies an enemy's ‘Twisting’ and ‘Buffering’.]

elements.label: Piercing
elements.description:
A brutal cold overflows, ensuring the arrival of the end.

[Using this to attack nullifies an enemy's ‘Resistant’ and ‘Revival’.]

elements.label: Profane
elements.description:
This object possesses unimaginable supernatural power, capable of even breaking through blessings and protections bestowed by gods.

[Cards with this aspect can ignore all special defenses of foes when attacking.]

elements.label: Cooling Down
elements.description: Every power has its limits; I must wait before I can invoke it again.

elements.label: Threshold: Edge
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Edge can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Forge
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Forge can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Grail
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Grail can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Heart
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Heart can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Secret History
elements.description: Invoking potential beneath Histories can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Knock
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Knock can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Lantern
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Lantern can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Moth
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Moth can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Winter
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Winter can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Molten Edge
elements.description: Invoking the forces of Edge and Forge in equal measure—or combining Edge with a certain sublime molten thing—can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Oblivion
elements.description:
The inner workings of this being harbor a destructive force—when it meets its end, this power shall be unleashed, coalescing into an annihilating vortex that obliterates everything within immediate reach.
[Upon the death of this foe, it will randomly draw in an item: consumables are destroyed, while tools and weapons enter a cooldown state.]

elements.label: Buffering
elements.description: This being's unique form makes it difficult to kill in a single strike. [Foes with this aspect are immune to the first attack, but lose this aspect once struck. You may also bypass this aspect by attacking with a molten weapon.]

elements.label: Resistant
elements.description: This being possesses extraordinary resilience, allowing it to potentially survive even under the most severe conditions. [foes with this aspect have a 30% chance to survive an otherwise fatal attack, unless you strike with a piercing weapon. ]

elements.label: Revival
elements.description: This being possesses unusual vitality, making it difficult to permanently subdue. [foes with this aspect require two attacks to be killed—otherwise they will recover after some time. A piercing weapon can nullify this property.]

elements.label: Sneaky
elements.description: This being is adept at concealing its presence. [foes with this aspect will enter a hidden form after attacking.]

elements.label: United
elements.description: This being attacks in swarms. [foes with this aspect will strike together with others of their kind, making them particularly dangerous when present in numbers.]

elements.label: Twisting
elements.description: This being is granted preservation by the Hour it serves, distorting reality around it, making ordinary weapons rarely effective. [Attacks against this enemy have only a 30% chance to succeed, unless a molten weapon is used.]

elements.label: Hidden: Lost Dead
elements.description:
此隐藏性相用于标记迷失亡者以触发集群特性，不论是正常状态还是隐匿均有此标记。

*此性相应被隐藏。

elements.label: Hidden
elements.description:
Nowhere to be found.

[You cannot attack foes in this state, but they can be revealed by using specific ability.]

elements.label: wild
elements.description:
此性相表明角色当前不处于城区。

[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: distance
elements.description:
用于标记到达目的地所需的进度。

[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: inregion1
elements.description:
此性相表明目标城市属于一区。

[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: inregion2
elements.description:
此性相表明目标城市属于二区。

[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Deadly
elements.description: Powerful foes can shatter your Health entirely when attacking.

elements.label: important
elements.description:
过于重要的资产是不会被吸取的。

[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Malice
elements.description:
A manifestation of a hostile Hour's power, currently permeating this reality.

[Can be utilized by certain foes, making them even more powerful.]

elements.label: Trade with Necessities
elements.description: Many things cannot be exchanged for money, but few things remain truly priceless in times of war.

elements.label: Local
elements.description: I cannot take this. [This card will be destroyed when changing regions.]

elements.label: Workable
elements.description: I can use this to use my own abilities.

elements.label: Forgeable
elements.description: I need a workshop to realize my plan for it.

elements.label: Consumable
elements.description: It has a disposable use.

elements.label: Foundry
elements.description: There is sufficient heat here for shaping. [You can craft items here, or use appropriate resources to restore one damaged Health.]

elements.label: Sun Shrine
elements.description: A secret cult site dedicated to the Solar Hours. [You may gain Influence here, or use appropriate resources to restore one damaged Reason.]

elements.label: The Vagabond's Steps
elements.description: The Vagabond once passed here and left a gift at the end of the road. [Completing the exploration will restore one damaged Passion — you may also choose to obtain a special Influence.]

elements.label: unfit
elements.description:
作者不希望你把这玩意丢到奇奇怪怪的地方。

[此性相应被隐藏，用于标记不具有准则的机会，他们不该被丢入挑战或铸造厂中。]

elements.label: Obstacle Count
elements.description: [You must overcome this many obstacles to achieve the outcome.]

elements.label: difficulty
elements.description: 模组判断游戏进程的标准，影响敌人ai和技能表现。流程越往后的城市，难度数值越高。

elements.label: Obstacle
elements.description: A difficulty that must be overcome.

elements.label: hidden mark: mind
elements.description: 判定卡牌是否是精神攻击的目标。

elements.label: Threat
elements.description:
An indicator used to gauge the danger level of foes. If left unattended, an obstacle that initially appears weak can grow to become extremely deadly.

[If this reaches 10, you will be in an extremely dangerous situation.]

elements.label: Goal
elements.description: This matter deserves a more detailed investigation and follow-up.

elements.label: Malice from Knot Gods
elements.description: Allows Garrisons of Triple Knot to utilize corresponding malice.

elements.label: purgemarkenemy
elements.description:
用于清除一般敌人相关卡牌。

[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: purgemarkparty
elements.description:
用于清除敌对团体相关卡牌。

[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: purgemarkhuntress
elements.description:
用于清除猎人相关卡牌。

[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: purgemarklogic
elements.description:
用于清除决定各类策略的逻辑卡排。

[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: purgemarkgeneral
elements.description:
用于在切换地区时清除对应卡牌。

[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Hurt
elements.description: A Name is not so easily killed unless they descend in person — but if I inflict enough harm, perhaps I can temporarily halt their actions. [Make this reaching 3 will keep you free from Hunters for an extended period.]

elements.label: blockcat
elements.description: 阻止老成仔猫入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: blockpig
elements.description: 阻止拉吉亚入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: blockpartymain
elements.description: 阻止Garrisons of Triple Knot入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: partymainishere
elements.description: Garrisons of Triple Knot已在此地。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: huntressishere
elements.description: 一名猎手已在此地。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: blockmove
elements.description: 使你无法离开当前地区。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: gamescore
elements.description: 计算demo版本中的收集数。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Mana Depleted
elements.description:
The ritual I performed has completely drained the residual power of this place. It remains open for worship, but the power once hidden within is no longer as it was.

[This sanctuary can no longer be used to restore Reason.]

elements.label: Heat Dissipates
elements.description:
My operations have caused some irreversible damage to the equipment in this area.

[This foundry can no longer be used to restore Health.]

elements.label: The Journey I Have Traveled
elements.description: I have walked so many long roads, and I will remember how to overcome the obstacles along the way.[These Progress will be retained.]
